notes.title: Sandbox mode and bug fixes
notes.content:
Sandbox/Training mode:

 options added to modify trainings mode. Unlocked opponents can be selected in sandbox mode for training.
 Surroundings now change. This is a basis for future changes to the environment

further:

 PC control have been slightly adjusted
 Smooth rotation for VR added
 small bug fixes

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed problems with Valve controllers preventing players from moving or rotating
- Fog is now displayed correctly in VR

notes.title: Small Fixes
notes.content:
- Tutorial can now be skipped by pressing and holding the esc-button
- Ability orbs can no longer be deselected
- Modifier tooltip & dice now show crystal icon as currency instead of coins
- general fixes

notes.title: NonVR update and roguelite elements
notes.content:
Big changes incoming!
We are happy to announce our latest update, which includes a non-VR version of Pandora. Whether you're a VR enthusiast or prefer a different experience, Pandora has got you covered.

We've also made the following changes:

Smooth Locomotion
You can now use smooth locomotion in VR in addition to the grab/pull mechanic

Tutorial rework
We heard your feedback about our previous tutorial and have revised it to make it even clearer and more user-friendly. Get ready for a smoother learning curve!

Leveling system
Unlock a whole new dimension of progression with our leveling system. Defeat foes or collect crystals to earn experience, unlocking permanent upgrades that elevate your gameplay.

Balancing
We're working hard to make sure everything in Pandora feels just right. We're tweaking each ability to make the game more fun and balanced for everyone to enjoy.
